events.title: BLACK ROOM presents PRAXYS Live
events.description: For the first time at Black Room, PRAXYS [LIVE] brings his signature live performance to M2. One of Colombia's leading techno artists, Praxys has performed at world renowned venues and events including Tresor Berlin, RSO Berlin, HÖR Berlin, and Baum Festival. Fresh off the release of his "Magnetic Chemistry EP" on Sam Paganini's JAM Records, he delivers a powerful live set blending raw hypnotic grooves, industrial energy, and cutting edge sound design, backed by support from artists such as Amelie Lens, Richie Hawtin, Charlotte de Witte, and Chris Liebing. Supporting the night are some of Miami's finest techno artists, CIMINO B2B JOVAN alongside DUVAN PRIETO bringing a special hybrid-live set, completing a lineup built for real techno lovers.
